column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/widgets/source_control.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in source_control.rs; the others
# move to src/widgets/source_control/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target source_control --check` after adding an item to source_control.rs.
# source_control.rs keeps the panel itself, SourceControlPanel, with its constructor, and the
# row action areas the drawing sets and the clicks read.
